page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-dense instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU operating at 2.5 GHz across 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs. The instance features 96 GB of system memory, providing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4 GB per vCPU. Hypervised via KVM, it offers an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

A core characteristic of the ecs.d1.6xlarge is its integrated local storage configuration, delivering 70866 GB of local hard disk drive capacity directly attached to the virtual machine. This high-density local storage profile provides substantial raw capacity for applications requiring large-scale data retention without relying exclusively on remote block storage arrays.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, bundling tens of terabytes of local HDD capacity with 24 dedicated vCPUs offers a high capacity-to-compute ratio suitable for big data processing, data warehousing, distributed file systems, and log analytics pipelines. Tradeoffs include the rotational latency inherent to HDD storage compared to solid-state media, making it best suited for sequential read and write workloads rather than high-random-IOPS database operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-dense virtual server powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 96 GB of system memory. Hypervised on KVM, the instance provides 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Its primary feature is a local storage array offering 70866 GB of local HDD storage capacity. This architecture delivers high storage density per core, making it cost-efficient for workloads requiring large-scale sequential data access and long-term local retention. The instance trades off the low latencies of solid-state drives for high raw storage volume. It is well suited for big data processing, log analytics, batch data processing, distributed storage nodes, and data warehousing tasks where sequential throughput and disk capacity are prioritized over random IOPS.
